title: If appetite fills the room, Naam cannot.
summary: Guru's question is not whether pleasure exists, but whether endless appetite has left any inward space for remembrance.
takeaway: What you feed all day eventually becomes what governs you.
lifeApplication: Refuse one small indulgence today just to prove your heart is not fully owned by it.

source.lifeApplication: Make room for Naam by interrupting one cycle of automatic consumption.

evidence.turn: Guard the tongue, and the heart begins to clear.
evidence.practicalImplication: Refuse one small indulgence today just to prove your heart is not fully owned by it.
